## Objective
The objective of this is to do a univariate "scan" - explore a range of candidate lymphocyte features 
to select for project inclusion

## Traditional pathologist features
- **Intraepithelial cellularity**
- **Intraepithelial clustering**
- **Lamina propria cellularity**
- **Lamina propria patchyness**
- **Distribution compared to junction**
- **Lymphocyte size**
- **Lymphocyte monomorphism**

## AI-derived lymphocyte features
- **Distance to closest lymphocyte** & **Lymphocyte count per 1000 um2**
- **Pct lymphocytes in clusters** 

 
- **Lymphocyte size**
Expect to correlate with pathologists assessment for size (average) and monomorphism (measure of spread)
Need to establish:
  - Method to aggregate by mucosal segment (mean and sd vs median and iqr) 
  Distribution single segment
  - Value of measuring separately for separate layers and compartments (correlation between villi epithelium and crypt epithelium and villi lamina propria and crypt lamina propria and epithelium and lamina propria)
  Pearson & scatterplot
  - Association between average and pathologists grade for size
  ANOVA and boxplot
  - Association between variability and pathologists grade for monomorphism
  ANOVA and boxplot
- **Distance to junction**
Expect to correlate with pathologists grade for junctional gradient.
  - Method to aggregate by mucosal segment (mean and sd vs median and iqr) 
  Segment distribution example
  - Correlation between mean and sd. 
  Pearson and scatterplot
  - Association between mean and pathologists grade for junctional distribution
  ANOVA and boxplot

library(jsonlite)

to_box <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/"
#to_box <- "C:/Users/15303/Box/" #JMW lenovo

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)   # pretty_breaks()

plot_hist_density_stats <- function(.data,
                                    value_var,
                                    n_breaks = 12,          # how many x-axis ticks
                                    title_prefix = "Distribution of") {

  # compute global summary stats
  stats <- summarise(.data,
                     median_val = median(.data[[ value_var ]], na.rm = TRUE),
                     q1        = quantile(.data[[ value_var ]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
                     q3        = quantile(.data[[ value_var ]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
                     mean_val  = mean(.data[[ value_var ]], na.rm = TRUE),
                     sd_val    = sd  (.data[[ value_var ]], na.rm = TRUE)) |>
           mutate(iqr       = q3 - q1,
                  upper_2sd = mean_val + 2 * sd_val,
                  lower_2sd = mean_val - 2 * sd_val)

  ggplot(.data, aes(x = .data[[ value_var ]])) +
    geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 30,
                   fill = "grey80", colour = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_density(colour = "blue", linewidth = 0.7) +

    # reference lines
    geom_vline(data = stats, aes(xintercept = median_val),  colour = "orange") +
    geom_vline(data = stats, aes(xintercept = q1),  colour = "lightgreen", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(data = stats, aes(xintercept = q3),  colour = "lightgreen", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(data = stats, aes(xintercept = mean_val),  colour = "darkred") +
    geom_vline(data = stats, aes(xintercept = upper_2sd), colour = "darkgreen", linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_vline(data = stats, aes(xintercept = lower_2sd), colour = "darkgreen", linetype = "dotted") +

    # nicer x-axis tick density
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = n_breaks)) +

    labs(title = paste(title_prefix, value_var),
         x = value_var,
         y = "Density") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")) +

    # summary text in the corner
    geom_text(data = stats,
              aes(x = Inf, y = Inf,
                  label = paste0("Median = ", round(median_val, 2), "\n",
                                 "IQR = ",   round(iqr, 2), "\n",
                                 "Mean = ",  round(mean_val, 2), "\n",
                                 "±2SD = [", round(lower_2sd, 2),
                                 ", ",       round(upper_2sd, 2), "]")),
              hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1, size = 3)
}


explore_features_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/explore_lymphocyte_distribution/")

### Explore lymphocyte counts
#### Objective
Lymphocyte count (normalized to surface area) is expected to correlate with pathologists cellularity grade. It is expected to be correlate (negatively) with distance to closest lymphocyte, but be more affected by regions without lymphocyte infiltrations (lower count if there are vast areas without lymphocytes but all lymphocytes are close together)
#### Need to establish
- **Transformation**
Right skewed as non-transformed but left skewed as transformed - use non-transformed
- **Normalization**
Not normaly distributed - use robust scaling
```{r}
lymphocyte_features <- fromJSON(paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/lymphocyte_distribution_features/feature_summaries/lymphocyte_feature_summaries_batch_1.json"))

counts <- lymphocyte_features %>%
  select(image_name:mucosa_name,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2,
         crypts_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2,
         villi_lamina_propria_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2,
         crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2) %>%
  mutate(across(
    where(is.numeric),
    ~(log10(.x) + 1),
    .names = "log_{.col}"
  )) %>%
  mutate(across(
    where(is.numeric),
    ~ (.x - median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)) / IQR(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    .names = "{.col}_robust"
  ))

to_plot <-  c("villi_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2", 
              "crypts_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2", 
              "villi_lamina_propria_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2",
              "crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2",
              "log_villi_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2",
              "log_crypts_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2", 
              "log_villi_lamina_propria_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2",
              "log_crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2")

for (var in to_plot){
  p <- plot_hist_density_stats(
  counts,
  value_var = var,
  n_breaks  = 12
) +
  labs(
    title = var,
    x     = var
  )
  
  ggsave(
  filename = paste0(explore_features_dir, var, ".png"),   # change as needed
  plot     = p,
  width    = 7,        # inches
  height   = 1.75,     # inches
  units    = "in",
  dpi      = 300 ) 
  
}

```



### Explore distance to closest lymphocyte 
#### Objective
Distance to closest lymphocyte is expected to correlate with 1) pathologists cellularity grade and 2) normalized lymphocyte count (lymphocytes per region area) but be more granular. 
Need to establish:
  - **Method to aggregate by mucosal segment (mean and sd vs median and iqr)**
  Assessed this by plotting the distribution of thw distance to closest neighbor for mucosal segments from labl_2020_tuning sample (fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_dsitribution.../output/lymphocyte_distribution_features/plots/lymphocytes_closest_neighbor_um vs. lympchocytes_log_closest_neighbor_um. Example for paper plotted below
  - **Method for normalization** - z-score vs. robust
  Based on distribution of values in pilot (batch 1).
  - Correlation between measure of centrality (mean) vs measure of variability (sd) - how much do they correlation 
  Pearson and correlation plot
  - **Correlation between means and sds**
  Mean and sd is expected to be positively correlated to some degree, since denser lymphocyte infiltration should have lower but more similar distances. This is to make sure the values are not too correlated (should still add information to use both for clustering)
  
  - **Correlation between mean and normalized count**
  Pearson and correlation plot
  
#### Decision
- **Method to aggregated by mucosal segment**: Mean and sd of log transformed values
- **Method for normalization**: Robust (by iqr). The distribution of both mean
and averages are often right skewed (for both epithelial and lamina propria
in both villi and crypts). Transforming again would jeopardize intreretability.
- **Correlation between mean distance and sd distance**
Mean and standard deviation for distance to closest lymphocytes were highly correlated in lamina
propria (0.89 for villi and 0.85 for crypts) but only moderately correlated for epithelium (0.56 for villi and 0.54 for crypts). Based on this alone I would drop sd distance for lamina propria (uninformative) but I am still interested in exploring how it relates to patchy lamina propria infiltration. Keep for now.
- **Correlation between mean distance and count**
Mean distance to closest lymphocyte and counts were highly negatively correlated in all layers and compartments (-0.68, villi epithelium, - 0.75 crypts epithelium, -0.74 villi lamina propria and -0.77 crypts lamina propria). At the lower and upper ends of the spectrum count tended to be more extreme than distance (slightly bent relation). Dropped count for all compartments.

#### To assess against pathologists grades
  - Association between mean and pathologists cellularity grade by compartment and layer
  ANOVA and boxplot
  - Correlation between sd and pathologists clustering grade (for epithelium)
  ANOVA and boxplot
  - Correlation between sd and pathologists patchy grade (for lamina propria)
  ANOVA and boxplot

### Explore pct lymphocytes in clusters
#### Objective
Pct lymphocytes in clusters is expected to correlate with pathologists cluster assessment for epithelum.
Need to establish:
- **Need for transformation** & **Method for normalization**
Based on distrbituion shape in pilot set
- **Cut-off for cluster**
5 commonly used in literature. If 3 correlates (expected) use that instead to gain info on lower ranges
- **Correlation with mean log distance to closest lymphocyte**
Expected negative correlation, but not similar enough to be redudant to include both.
- **Correlation with sd log distance to closest lymphocyte**
Expected negative correlation, but not similar enough to be redudant to include both.

#### Decision
- **Need for transformation**: 
Non-transformed is right-tailed but log transformed is left-tailed. Keeping it non-transformed
- **Method for normalization**: 
Robust (medium centered, IQR corrected)
- **Correlation between 3 and 5 as cluster cutoff**
Very highly correlated - use 3 as cut off
- **Correlation between pct cluster and mean log dist**
Higher (negative) then expected (-0.71 for villi epithelium)  -still keep
- **Correlation between pct cluster and sd log dist**
Lower (negative) then expected (-0.62 for villi epithelium) - keep
#### To assess against pathologists grades
  - Association between pct_clusters pathologists grade by compartment and layer
  ANOVA and boxplot
  
```{r clustering}
#Temporary subset for villi epithelium
pct_clusters_ie_villi <- lymphocyte_features %>%
  select(villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_pct_cluster_ge_3,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_pct_cluster_ge_5,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um, 
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_log_closest_neighbor_um) %>%
  mutate(
    log_villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_pct_cluster_ge_3 =
      log10(villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_pct_cluster_ge_3) + 1,
    log_villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_pct_cluster_ge_5 =
      log10(villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_pct_cluster_ge_5) + 1) %>%
  mutate(across(
    where(is.numeric),
    ~ (.x - median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)) / IQR(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    .names = "{.col}_robust"
  ))

#Select method for normalization 
p_raw <- plot_hist_density_stats(
  pct_clusters_ie_villi,
  value_var = "villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_pct_cluster_ge_3",
  n_breaks  = 12
) +
  labs(
    title = "% lymphocytes in clusters of 3 or more\n
    Villi epithelium",
    x     = "% lymphocytes in clusters of 3 or more"
  )

### Lymphocyte size
Expect to correlate with pathologists assessment for size (average) and monomorphism (measure of spread)
Need to establish:
- **Method to aggregate by mucosal segment** (mean and sd vs median and iqr) 
  Distribution single segment
- **Value of measuring separately for separate layers and compartments** (correlation between villi epithelium and crypt epithelium and villi lamina propria and crypt lamina propria and epithelium and lamina propria)
  Pearson & scatterplot
#### Decision
- **Method to aggregate by mucosal segment** 
This is normally distributed (non-transformed) - mean and sd summarizes well
- **Method for normlization** 
Mean Also normally distributed between segments, z-score would have worked well but use robust to be consistent across variables
- **correlation crypt villi**
Lamina propria lymphocyte size, has higher correlation between crypts and villi than epithelial lymphocyte size. I wonder if false positive epithelial cells in crypt region contributes. Keep to see
if it helps poor performance cluster out. 
#### To compare with pathologist
  - Association between average and pathologists grade for size
  ANOVA and boxplot
  - Association between variability and pathologists grade for monomorphism
  ANOVA and boxplot
### Distance to junction

### Distance to junction
- *aggregate?*
Median and iqr of log-transformed
Irregular both as non-transformed (right skewed, irregular) and transformed (left-skewed slightly smoother)
- *normalize*
Both median and iqr of the log transformed distance are unexpectedly normal distributed
across segments. Z-score would have worked but use robust scaling to stay consistent
- *correlations villi vs crypt*
Neither intraepithelial nor lamina propria lymphocyte distance to junction correlate across layers. 
Suspsect since this is more driven by orientation then biology. Consider excluding.
```{r}
junction <- lymphocyte_features %>%
  select(image_name:mucosa_name,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_median_log_closest_junction_um,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_iqr_log_closest_junction_um,

         crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_iqr_log_closest_junction_um,

  mutate(across(
    where(is.numeric),
    ~(log10(.x) + 1),
    .names = "log_{.col}"
  )) %>%
    
  mutate(across(
    where(is.numeric),
    ~ (.x - median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)) / IQR(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    .names = "{.col}_robust"
  ))

Expect to correlate with 1) pathologists cellularity grade and 2) normalized lymphocyte count (lymphocytes per region area) but be more granular. 
Need to establish:
  - Method to aggregate by mucosal segment (mean and sd vs median and iqr) 
  - Correlation bewteen measure of centrality (mean) vs measure of variability (sd) - how much do they correlate.
  - Correlation between mean and normalized count
  - Association between mean and pathologists cellularity grade
  - Correlation between sd and clustering measure (for epithelium)
  - Correlation between sd and pathologists pathcy grade (for lamina propria)
  
  - Information of measure of 
Also check how summary of variability in a segment correlate with clustering measures (pathologist grade and AI-derived measure)

- **lymphocyte cellularity**
  - *lymphocytes_median_log_closest_neighbor_um* (left skewed - log transformation and median iqr)
  - *lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2*
  - *epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio*
  
- **patchy infiltration / clustering**
  - *lymphocytes_cluster_median_closest_neighbor_um*
  - *lymphocytes_cluster_count_per_1000_um2*
  - *lymphocytes_cluster_iqr_log_closest_neighbor_um*
  - *lymphocytes_cluster_median_cluster_n_lymphocytes*
  - *lymphocytes_cluster_iqr_log_cluster_n_lymphocytes *
  - *lymphocytes_cluster_iqr_log_closest_junction_um*
  - *lymphocytes_iqr_log_closest_neighbor_um * (left skewed - log transformation and median iqr) - low - clusters?

- **junctional_gradient**
  -*median_log_closest_junction_um*(left skewed - log transformation makes it right skewed)
  -*lymphocytes_cluster_median_log_closest_junction_um*
 
- **size**
  -*mean_measured_area_um2 *
- **heterogeneity**
  -*sd_measured_area_um2 *





### Explore 

**Intraepithelial lymphocyte cellularity"  - villi

#### Candidate features
- **villi_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2**
  -Similar to our previous paper but by mucosal segment and layer.
  - Similar values for clustered and unclustered lymphocytes around average count
  - Log transformation gives a better curve
  - unclear relevance of second peak - overall pretty low counts mixed with non-mucosal segments

- **villi_epithelium_lymphocyte_mean_log_distance_to_closest_neighbor**
  - Gives more granularity in that it together with sd captures distribution over segment




```{r}

villi_ie_cellularity_features <- lymphocyte_features %>% select(
  image_name:mucosa_name,
  villi_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2,
  villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um, 
  villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_log_closest_neighbor_um,
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log_villi_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2 = 
      log10(villi_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2) + 1) %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(log_villi_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2, villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um, villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_log_closest_neighbor_um),
    ~(.x - median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)) / IQR(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    .names = "{.col}_robust"
  ))

# Log-transformed counts
p_log <- plot_hist_density_stats(
  villi_ie_cellularity_features,
  value_var = "log_villi_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2",
  n_breaks  = 14
) +
  labs(
    title = "Normalized lymphocyte counts - log transformed",
    x     = "Log₁₀ (lymphocytes per 1000 µm²)"   # adjust wording if needed
  )

```{r}
library(dplyr)


vars <- c(
  "villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um_robust",
  "villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_log_closest_neighbor_um_robust",
  "villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_pct_cluster_ge_3_robust"
)

# 1  Create the feature matrix (no extra scaling)
X <- select_features %>%          # replace with your segment-level data frame
  select(all_of(vars)) %>% 
  as.matrix()                 # kmeans needs a numeric matrix/data.frame

# quick check
stopifnot(ncol(X) == 3)       # should pass without error

# 2  Elbow-plot WSS
set.seed(42)
k_max <- 25
wss <- sapply(1:k_max, function(k) {
  kmeans(X, centers = k, nstart = 25)$tot.withinss
})

# 3  Plot
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data.frame(k = 1:k_max, wss = wss), aes(k, wss)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:k_max) +
  labs(title = "Elbow plot for k-means",
       x = "Number of clusters (k)",
       y = "Total within-cluster SS") +
  theme_minimal()

set.seed(42)                 # reproducible
k    <- 6                    # or 7
km   <- kmeans(X, centers = k, nstart = 25)

select_features$cluster <- factor(km$cluster) 

library(ggplot2)
pcs <- prcomp(X)                     # PCA on the same scaled matrix
pca_df <- data.frame(pcs$x[, 1:2],   # take PC1 & PC2
                     cluster = select_features$cluster)

ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  stat_ellipse(type = "norm", linetype = 2) +
  labs(title = paste("k-means, k =", k, " — PCA projection"),
       x = "PC1", y = "PC2") +
  theme_minimal()

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)        # for log_breaks() / log_minor_breaks()

minor_breaks_log10 <- function() {
  function(lims) {                    # lims = c(min, max) in raw units
    rng  <- range(log10(lims))
    decs <- floor(rng[1]):ceiling(rng[2])
    as.numeric(outer(1:9, 10^decs, `*`))   # 1–9 × 10^each decade
  }
}

scale_x_log10(
  breaks       = scales::log_breaks(base = 10),
  minor_breaks = minor_breaks_log10(),
  labels       = scales::label_comma()
)


offset      <- 1                     # same offset as in aes()
distance_var   <- "villi_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2"

# ----- summary stats on the raw (+offset) scale -----
x_raw <- lymphocyte_features[[distance_var]] + offset
median_raw <- median(x_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
q1_raw     <- quantile(x_raw, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
q3_raw     <- quantile(x_raw, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

# ----- plot -----
ggplot(lymphocyte_features, aes(x = x_raw)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)),
                 bins = 30,
                 fill = "grey80", colour = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_density(colour = "blue", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median_raw, colour = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = q1_raw,     colour = "darkgreen", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = q3_raw,     colour = "darkgreen", linetype = "dashed") +

  # ---------- denser log axis ----------
  scale_x_log10(
  breaks       = scales::log_breaks(base = 10),
  minor_breaks = minor_breaks_log10(),
  labels       = scales::label_comma()
) +

  # optional: faint vertical minor grid lines for easier reading
  theme_bw(base_size = 9, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey85"),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +

  labs(
    x     = paste(distance_var, "(per 1000 µm²)"), 
    y     = "Density",
    title = paste("Distribution of", distance_var, "on log-10 scale")
  )
```

# 2.  Recalculate summary statistics on the transformed values
median_val <- median(lymphocyte_features[[log_distance_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
q1         <- quantile(lymphocyte_features[[log_distance_var]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
q3         <- quantile(lymphocyte_features[[log_distance_var]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
iqr        <- q3 - q1

# 3.  Plot the transformed distribution
ggplot(lymphocyte_features, aes(x = .data[[log_distance_var]])) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)),
                 bins = 30, fill = "grey80", color = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_density(color = "blue", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median_val, color = "red",   linetype = "solid",  linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = q1,         color = "darkgreen", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = q3,         color = "darkgreen", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Log-transformed distribution of", distance_var),
    x     = paste0("log10(", distance_var, " + 1)"),
    y     = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    label = paste0("Median = ", round(median_val, 2),
                   "\nIQR = ",   round(iqr, 2)),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1,
    size = 3, family = "Arial"
  )

  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)),

  geom_density(colour = "blue", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median_val + offset, colour = "red") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_comma()) +           # <- log axis, human labels
  labs(x = paste(distance_var, "(per 1000 µm²)"), 
       title = paste("Distribution of", distance_var, "on log scale"))


breaks_raw <- c(0, 1, 5, 10, 50, 100, 500, 1000)   # pick break values you like
offset     <- 1                                    # same offset

ggplot(lymphocyte_features,
       aes(x = .data[[log_distance_var]])) +       # logged data column
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)),
                 bins = 30, fill = "grey80", colour = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_density(colour = "blue", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log10(median_val + offset), colour = "red") +
  scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = log10(breaks_raw + offset),       # where the ticks sit
        labels = breaks_raw                        # what the ticks say
  ) +
  labs(x = paste(distance_var, "(per 1000 µm²)"), 
       title = paste("Distribution of", distance_var, "on log scale"))

offset <- 1                     # same value you add inside aes()

# *** Re-compute the summary on the *same* vector you give ggplot ***

q1_raw       <- quantile(lymphocyte_features[[distance_var]] + offset, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)

library(dplyr); library(ggplot2)

offset <- 1                               # same offset as in aes()

# ---------- 1. get the exact breaks the histogram will use ----------
hist_info   <- hist(lymphocyte_features[[distance_var]] + offset,
                   breaks = 30,           # same `bins = 30` you give ggplot
                   plot   = FALSE)
breaks_raw  <- hist_info$breaks           # 31 break points (left edges + rightmost edge)

# ---------- 2. recompute your summary stats on the *same* vector ----------
median_raw  <- median(lymphocyte_features[[distance_var]] + offset, na.rm = TRUE)
q1_raw      <- quantile(lymphocyte_features[[distance_var]] + offset, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
q3_raw      <- quantile(lymphocyte_features[[distance_var]] + offset, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

# ---------- 3. plot ----------
ggplot(lymphocyte_features,
       aes(x = .data[[distance_var]] + offset)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)),
                 breaks = breaks_raw,     # << use the same breaks
                 fill = "grey80", colour = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_density(colour = "blue", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median_raw, colour = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = q1_raw,     colour = "darkgreen", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = q3_raw,     colour = "darkgreen", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_log10(
        breaks       = breaks_raw,               # tick at every bar edge
        minor_breaks = NULL,                     # keep it clean
        labels       = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  labs(x = paste(distance_var, "(per 1000 µm²)"))

  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    label = paste0("Median = ", round(median_val, 2), "\nIQR = ", round(iqr, 2)),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1,
    size = 3, family = "Arial"
  )

### Check correlations between features

```{r}
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(GGally)



lymphocyte_features_all <- fromJSON(paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/lymphocyte_distribution_features/feature_summaries/lymphocyte_feature_summaries_batch_1.json"))


lymphocyte_features <- lymphocyte_features_all %>%
  select(image_name:mucosa_name, 
         villi_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_log_closest_neighbor_um,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_pct_cluster_ge_3,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2,
         crypts_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2,
         crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um,
         crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_log_closest_neighbor_um,
         crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_pct_cluster_ge_3,
         crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2,
         crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2,
         villi_lamina_propria_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2,
         villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um,
         villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_sd_log_closest_neighbor_um,
         villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_pct_cluster_ge_3,
         villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2,
         villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2,
         crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2,
         crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um,
         crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_sd_log_closest_neighbor_um,
         crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_pct_cluster_ge_3,
         crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2,
         crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2
         
         ) %>%
  mutate(across(
    where(is.numeric),
    ~ (.x - median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)) / IQR(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    .names = "{.col}_robust"
  ))
```

### Check correlations between variables within each compartment

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(GGally)
library(plotly)

explore_features_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/explore_lymphocyte_distribution/")

scaled_df <- lymphocyte_features %>%
  select(ends_with("_robust"))

make_abbr <- function(nms) {
  nms %>%
    str_remove("_robust$") %>%                                   # drop suffix
    str_replace("^villi_epithelium",         "vil_ep") %>%
    str_replace("^crypts_epithelium",        "cry_ep") %>%
    str_replace("^villi_lamina_propria",     "vil_lp") %>%
    str_replace("^crypts_lamina_propria",    "cry_lp") %>%
    str_replace("_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2$",             "Count")  %>%
    str_replace("_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um$",  "Dist-mean") %>%
    str_replace("_lymphocytes_sd_log_closest_neighbor_um$",    "Dist-sd")   %>%
    str_replace("_lymphocytes_pct_cluster_ge_3$",              "Cluster")  %>%
    str_replace("_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2$",        "Size-mean") %>%
    str_replace("_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2$",          "Size-sd")   %>%
    str_replace("^(vil_ep|cry_ep|vil_lp|cry_lp)_(.*)$", "\\1\n\\2")
}

groups <- list(
  vil_ep = "^villi_epithelium_.*_robust$",
  vil_lp = "^villi_lamina_propria_.*_robust$",
  cry_ep = "^crypts_epithelium_.*_robust$",
  cry_lp = "^crypts_lamina_propria_.*_robust$"
)

walk(
  names(groups),
  \(g) {
    df   <- lymphocyte_features %>% select(matches(groups[[g]]))
    abbr <- make_abbr(names(df)) |>
        stringr::str_remove("^(vil_ep|cry_ep|vil_lp|cry_lp)\\n?") 

    p <- ggpairs(
      df,
      columnLabels = abbr,
      lower = list(continuous = wrap("points", alpha = .5, size = .6)),
      upper = list(continuous = wrap("cor", digits = 2, size = 3)),
      diag  = list(continuous = "densityDiag")
    ) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6)
      )

     ggsave(
      filename = file.path(explore_features_dir, glue::glue("{g}_pair_matrix.png")),
      plot     = p,
      width    = 7, height = 7, units = "in", dpi = 300
    )
  }
)

```


### Check correlation between compartments for each variable

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(GGally)
library(plotly)

explore_features_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/explore_lymphocyte_distribution/")

scaled_df <- lymphocyte_features %>%
  select(ends_with("_robust"))

make_abbr <- function(nms) {
  nms %>%
    str_remove("_robust$") %>%                                   # drop suffix
    str_replace("^villi_epithelium",         "Villi-Epi") %>%
    str_replace("^crypts_epithelium",        "Crypts-Epi") %>%
    str_replace("^villi_lamina_propria",     "Villi-Lp") %>%
    str_replace("^crypts_lamina_propria",    "Crypts-Lp") %>%
    str_replace("_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2$",             " Count")  %>%
    str_replace("_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um$",  " Dist-mean") %>%
    str_replace("_lymphocytes_sd_log_closest_neighbor_um$",    " Dist-sd")   %>%
    str_replace("_lymphocytes_pct_cluster_ge_3$",              " Cluster")  %>%
    str_replace("_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2$",        " Size-mean") %>%
    str_replace("_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2$",          " Size-sd")  
}

groups <- list(
  count      = "_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2_robust$",              # …Count
  dist_mean  = "_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um_robust$",   # …Dist-mean
  dist_sd    = "_lymphocytes_sd_log_closest_neighbor_um_robust$",     # …Dist-sd
  clust      = "_lymphocytes_pct_cluster_ge_3_robust$",               # …Cluster
  size_mean  = "_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2_robust$",         # …Size-mean
  size_sd    = "_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2_robust$"            # …Size-sd
)

walk(
  names(groups),
  \(g) {
    df   <- lymphocyte_features %>% select(matches(groups[[g]]))
    abbr <- make_abbr(names(df)) 
    p <- ggpairs(
      df,
      columnLabels = abbr,
      lower = list(continuous = wrap("points", alpha = .5, size = .6)),
      upper = list(continuous = wrap("cor", digits = 2, size = 3)),
      diag  = list(continuous = "densityDiag")
    ) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6)
      )

     ggsave(
      filename = file.path(explore_features_dir, glue::glue("{g}_pair_matrix.png")),
      plot     = p,
      width    = 7, height = 7, units = "in", dpi = 300
    )
  }
)
